target: Final Democratic-minus-Republican raw vote-share margin, in percentage points, for identity-matched regular general Senate races
diagnosticInterpretation: Chronological outcome diagnostic on a newly captured polling archive. Revised final data and already-known election outcomes prevent claims of an original untouched forecast vintage or trading profit.
aggregation: Last available median-field-date observation for each independent pollster per race at the stated forecast horizon; at most one source per pollster; fixed recency weights; one observation and equal weight per race in error calibration.
errorDistribution: Fixed Student-t4; arithmetic mean and RMS around that mean for historical_bias_corrected, zero location and raw RMS for poll_centered. Calibration uses strictly earlier election years; no future pollster rating or national result enters a feature.
population: The historical collector does not expose LV/RV population. Mixed-population errors cannot establish a specific RV-to-LV adjustment or empirical weighting preference.
exclusions: Source and independently checked final outcome disagreement
